causal_attributions.event_name: SMART Interest Rate & Lending Cap Removal
causal_attributions.root_cause_why: Bangladesh Bank replaced fixed 9% lending cap with SMART rate, later moving to pure market-based repo tightening (repo hiked to 8.5%-10.0%). Corporate borrowing cost surged from 9% to 14-16%.
Mass protests, nationwide curfews, internet blackouts, supply chain shutdowns leading to resignation of government on Aug 5.
Interim government established under Dr. Yunus. BSEC leadership replaced, investigation task force formed against financial market manipulators and money laundering.

causal_attributions.event_name: Banking NPL Revelations & Aggressive Monetary Tightening

FX reserves stabilized with IMF/World Bank assistance. Remittance surge. Selective institutional accumulation into debt-free cash cows with high dividend yields (Square, GP, Olympic, Padma Oil).
